answer: Stop seating the same pair of graders together too often. Once two accounts have shared 3 panels in the last 20 epochs, the draw won't put them on one panel again until an old one drops out of that window. In a big pool honest graders almost never hit that, so nothing changes for them. A farm is different. Its clones keep landing next to each other, which is how they stack a vote on a junk velvet pricing sheet or a falcon count under some bridge. With the cap they get spread thin, so holding a majority anywhere takes far more accounts, each aged and active.
